author: maya.okafor
message: Tighten payment gateway timeout from 5s to 2s and add retry wrapper
diff_summary: Reduced PAYMENT_GATEWAY_TIMEOUT_MS from 5000 to 2000 and wrapped authorize() in a 3-attempt retry with no backoff.

author: dan.velasquez
message: Add structured logging for checkout confirmation flow
diff_summary: Added trace-id propagation and JSON log fields to POST /api/checkout/confirm handlers. No behavioral change.

author: priya.raman
message: Reduce DB pool max size from 20 to 5 to cut idle connections on RDS
diff_summary: Lowered SQLAlchemy pool_size from 20 to 5 and max_overflow from 10 to 0 to reduce RDS connection pressure.

author: leo.martins
message: Enable synonym expansion in query parser
diff_summary: Query parser now expands each token against the synonym dictionary before hitting Elasticsearch; no cap on expanded term count.

author: sofia.nguyen
message: Cache user embeddings in-process to cut feature-store reads
diff_summary: Added module-level dict caching user embedding tensors keyed by user_id. No eviction policy yet (TODO).

diff_summary: Replaced sleep-based wait with polling assertion. Test-only change.
